question.prompt: A store's sales (in items) over the past 6 months were 40, 45, 52, 58, 63, and 70, respectively, increasing by approximately 6 items per month. The predicted sales for next month are closest to

solutions.explanation: Sales increased by a total of \(70-40=30\) items over the 6 months, an average increase of approximately 6 items per month. Therefore, next month's sales will be approximately \(70+6=76\) items.
solutions.title: Continue the monthly trend
